title: Courtesy Reissue of an Expired Finch Note — Finch Circle Care Desk Guidance
content:
The Finch Circle Loyalty Program allows a lapsed Finch Note to come back once as a courtesy, on the following terms.

1. **What may be reissued.** A Finch Note that lapsed because its validity ended may be reissued once as a courtesy, issued for the reason "courtesy reissue", at the member's request, the request being recorded as an expired note reissue request.
2. **Reissue window.** The request is made within the reissue window after the note's expiry date. The window counts calendar days starting the day after the expiry date as day 1, and a request on the last day of the window is in time. The expiry date is read from the lapsed note's issue entry in the member's note history.
3. **Rolling allowance.** The number of notes issued for the reason "courtesy reissue" on the membership in the rolling 12 calendar months ending on the handling date, counted by issue date, is below the tier's courtesy reissue allowance, read for the tier held on the request date.
4. **The reissued note.** The reissued note has the original note's value, names the original note's code, and its expiry date is the reissue date plus the courtesy note validity days, less one day.
5. **Never reissued.** A note that lapsed because the membership closed, a note already reissued once, and a birthday note are never reissued.

**Status of clauses 1 and 4.** Clauses 1 and 4 are no longer in force for a courtesy reissue of the member's most recently lapsed note: for that reissue the note that may be reissued, and the value and expiry of the reissued note, are those of the current courtesy reissue basis. Clauses 2, 3 and 5 remain in force for every courtesy reissue.

The reissue window and the courtesy reissue allowance of each tier are those of the reinstated and courtesy note terms.

## Window boundary (hypothetical, 30-day window)

| Note expiry date | Day 1 of the window | Last day of the window | Request on 10 July | Request on 11 July |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 June | 11 June | 10 July | in time | late |

## Allowance cases (hypothetical)

| Tier held on the request date | Allowance | Courtesy reissues issued in the rolling 12 months | Clause 3 met |
|---|---|---|---|
| Finch Circle Silver | 0 | 0 | no |
| Finch Circle Gold | 1 | 0 | yes |
| Finch Circle Gold | 1 | 1 | no |
| Finch Circle Icon | 2 | 1 | yes |

superseded_clauses: A Finch Note that lapsed with expire_reason validity_ended may be reissued once as a courtesy (issue_reason courtesy_reissue) at the member's request, recorded as a loyalty_requests record with request_type expired_note_reissue.
The reissued note has the original note_amount, names the original_note_code, and its expiry_date is the reissue date plus courtesy_note_validity_days minus one day.
